skill_name: Explain how two given processes work.
workflow: Natural selection is the process by which organisms adapt and evolve over time in response to changes in their environment. It is driven by the “survival of the fittest” principle, where those individuals with more desirable traits are more likely to reproduce and pass their genes onto the next generation, while those with less desirable traits perish.
